title: 第九章 罗兰庄园探险记第十章 遗物
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工

;;
“卡夫居然骗我？而且卡夫身上那股保护欲是怎么回事？难道说是诡术师的技能？”躺在床上的林奇想到。
在答应了舅舅会离卡夫远点之后他们就回房休息了。
林奇住的还是之前他自己在罗兰庄园的房间，而伊莱娜则被安排在了他旁边的那个房间。
临走时奥尔丁还神秘兮兮的说他们两个的房间附近没有其他人住......
真是的，把我林某人想成什么人了？
林奇走出了房间，来到了隔壁敲了敲门。
咔——房门打开，是一脸睡眼惺忪的伊莱娜。
“干嘛？我好困。”穿着睡衣的伊莱娜揉了揉眼睛问道。
林奇咽了咽口水，说实话穿常服的时候感觉不出来，伊莱娜居然这么有料。
“我打算在庄园内找关于罗兰家族历史的秘闻。你要不要来帮我？”林奇问道。
“不要，我要睡觉了。”
“你知道的，我从小就是私生子。对于罗兰家族的历史......”
伊莱娜看着林奇故作的可怜的样子叹了口气：“我知道了，等会我换身衣服。”
ok，计划通。等会先去书房看看，那些带着铁锁的书籍让林奇很在意。
书居然用铁锁锁在书架上面，这种行为也太奇怪了。
然后再去大厅上画着家族历史的壁画上看看有没有什么收获，正想着，房门再次打开。
换了一身便装的伊莱娜走出了房门。
“走吧。”走廊窗户的月光照耀在她银白色的发丝上给人一种沉静的感觉，白玉般的手臂上戴着那副疑似禁物的手镯......
“发什么呆，快走啊。”看着林奇呆愣在原地伊莱娜又再次叫了一声。

“哦哦，来了。”
该死的，都怪舅舅一直在耳朵边说着什么结婚，生孩子的话题搞得林奇心有些乱，这十几岁的年纪就是容易胡思乱想。
俩人一路来到了二楼的书房处。
两人蹑手蹑脚的打开了书房的门。
只见伊莱娜手掌一翻手中便出现了一盏油灯，这就是那个手镯禁物的能力？
介不系统背包吗？怪不得伊莱娜没有行李还有这么多套衣服。
“这里面都有什么吗？”在后面提着油灯的伊莱娜向正在书架上摸索的林奇问道。
“我也不知道有什么，只是这些书都用锁头锁着让我有些在意。”
拿起其中一个锁头仔细查看锁眼的林奇并未回头。
林奇对着眼前的锁扣动用了引力线，无形的丝线进入了锁孔内部，只听“咔”的一声阻拦林奇查看书籍的最后一道障碍也消失了。
林奇将锁头内部的书籍拿了出来，还没等他查看只听叮的一声。
【已获得超凡知识：生命途径：自然序列：序列9牧树人】
【解锁方式：亲手创造一个生命、一件蕴含生命力的物品、三种不同种类的毛发。】
？？？
这本书里夹杂着超凡知识？
而且还是自然序列，自然序列的解锁方式看似很离谱实际上很简单。
比如亲手创造一个生命的意思就是种个土豆......或者其他东西都可以，只要你把一个种子种下等他成熟就算你创造了一个生命。
蕴含生命力的物品大多数玩家选择的是玩家商店的生命药水......
三种毛发就更简单了，人类的毛发和其他两种动物的毛发。
这一本书是自然序列那岂不是说......

林奇看着书架上剩余的十一本书如坠冰窟。

"Kraft actually lied to me? And what's the matter with Kraft's protective desire? Could it be the skill of a trickster?" Lynch thought while lying on the bed.
After promising their uncle that they would stay away from Kraft, they went back to their room to rest.
Lynch stayed in his previous room in Roland Manor, while Elena was arranged in the room next to him.
Before leaving, Aldin mysteriously said that no one else lived near their room...
Really, who do you think I, Lin, am?
Lynch walked out of the room, went to the next door and knocked on the door.
Click - the door opened, and it was Elena with a sleepy look on her face.
"What are you doing? I'm so sleepy." Elena, wearing pajamas, rubbed her eyes and asked.
Lin Qi swallowed. To be honest, he couldn't feel it when wearing regular clothes. Elena was so confident.
"I plan to find out the secrets about Roland's family history in the manor. Do you want to help me?" Lynch asked.
"No, I'm going to bed."
"You know, I have been an illegitimate child since I was a child. Regarding the history of the Roland family..."
Elena looked at Lynch's pretending to be pitiful and sighed: "I know, I'll change clothes later."
OK, the plan goes through. I'll go to the study room to take a look later. Lynch is very concerned about those books with iron locks.
The books are actually locked on the bookshelf with iron locks. This behavior is too strange.
Then I went to see if I could gain anything from the mural depicting family history in the hall. Just as I was thinking about it, the door opened again.
Elena, who changed into casual clothes, walked out of the room.
"Let's go." The moonlight from the corridor window shone on her silver-white hair, giving her a sense of calmness. On her jade-like arms, she wore a pair of bracelets that seemed to be forbidden items...
"Why are you dazed? Let's go quickly." Seeing Lin Qi stunned in place, Elena shouted again.
"Oh, here we come."
Damn it, it was all because his uncle kept talking about marriage and having children in his ears, which made Lin Qi feel a little confused. It was easy for him to have random thoughts at this teenage age.
The two of them arrived at the study room on the second floor.
The two quietly opened the study door.
I saw Elena turning her palm and an oil lamp appeared in her hand. Is this the ability of the forbidden object of the bracelet?
Do you mind the system backpack? No wonder Elena has so many sets of clothes without luggage.
"Is there anything in here?" Elena, who was holding an oil lamp in the back, asked Lynch who was groping on the bookshelf.
"I don't know what it is, but the fact that these books are locked with locks makes me a little concerned."
Lynch picked up one of the locks and examined the keyhole carefully without looking back.
Lynch used the gravitational thread on the lock in front of him. The invisible thread entered the keyhole, and with a click, the last obstacle that prevented Lynch from checking the book disappeared.
Lynch took out the book from inside the lock, and before he could check it, he heard a ding.
[Acquired extraordinary knowledge: Life path: Natural sequence: Sequence 9 tree shepherd]
[Unlocking method: Create a life, an item containing vitality, and three different types of hair with your own hands. 】
? ? ?
Is this book filled with extraordinary knowledge?
Moreover, it is also a natural sequence. The way to unlock the natural sequence may seem outrageous but is actually very simple.
For example, creating a life with your own hands means planting a potato...or anything else. As long as you plant a seed and wait for it to mature, you have created a life.
Items containing vitality. Most players choose the life potion from the player store...
Three types of hair are even simpler, human hair and two other animal hairs.
This book is a natural sequence. Doesn’t that mean...
Lynch looked at the remaining eleven books on the bookshelf as if they had fallen into an ice cave.
